limitations: Measured four small 2D Helmholtz cases, 81-2401 DOFs, on one GPU; no universal speedup claim.
Warm timed window excludes context/module initialization, initial setup and explicit output/reference computation.
First-action preprocessing cost is warmed out; cold preparation timings do not include this deferred work.
Requires runtime cusparseSpMV_preprocess support; opt-in remains explicit pending broader workloads.
Existing allocation-quota/vendor-scratch coverage gaps remain open.
